message.content:
This editorial illustration features a light purple background populated by nine stylized human figures. At the top, white text reads "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KARTINI" above a large pink title, "TEMPO". Below this, smaller text reads "18-24 APRIL 2016" and larger white text reads "PEREMPUAN PENEMBUS BATAS". 

In the top left, a woman in a yellow top and black-and-white striped pants uses an orange megaphone. To the top right, a figure in a pink shirt and white skirt holds a yellow bag and an open book. Below the central text, a woman in a white lab coat peers into a black microscope. To her right, a woman in a patterned headscarf and orange tunic uses a white laptop. On the bottom left, a woman in an orange top holds a red card marked with a white "A". Beside her, a figure in light blue medical attire holds a white folder. To the right, a woman in a yellow dress adjusts teal fabric on a black mannequin. In the bottom right, a figure wears a black scuba suit with yellow accents and fins. Stylized colorful leaves, white water droplets, and geometric diagrams are scattered throughout. A barcode and "RP 39.500" are printed at the bottom.
